retrievalProfile.description: A warm, intimate profile portrait featuring a combination of structured condensed sans-serif and expressive, large-scale vertical script overlays.
triggerTerms: warm profile portrait with vertical script
excludeWhen: landscape-only photography without a human subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up profile of a subject in soft, warm natural light, framed by textured hair, paired with a dual-typographic system consisting of a clean condensed sans-serif and a large, gestural hand-drawn script that acts as a framing device.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm golden-hour lighting reflecting off the subject's hair and skin
Contrast between the rigid geometry of the sans-serif and the fluid motion of the script
Subject's downward gaze creating a mood of introspection
Text placement that utilizes the negative space to the left of the profile
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation for the primary script element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame in a tight profile shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical script downward, then moves across the subject's profile to the textured hair on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third of the composition is relatively open, providing a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and copper tones in the hair and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and shadows providing depth in the hair and facial features.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red for the script typography to stand out against the warm background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with high value in the highlights, creating a soft, glowing effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed geometric sans-serif and gestural monoline script.
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: High x-height, narrow width, uniform stroke weight.
Script: Continuous monolinear stroke, large loops, vertical orientation.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'R' features an elongated top loop that encircles the secondary text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, dark all-caps sans-serif and a fluid, red vertical script.
graphicDevices: Enclosing loop from the script 'R' to frame the secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and narrow proportions of the secondary text.
The primary text requires a hand-drawn, gestural quality that standard fonts lack.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned profile portrait of a woman with reddish-brown hair, looking down thoughtfully, with soft golden-hour lighting and a blurred natural background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, vertical, hand-drawn red script on the left side. Place a condensed all-caps sans-serif title in dark brown at the top left, partially framed by the top loop of the script.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and golden?
Does the script loop frame the secondary text?
Is the secondary text a condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos

mustAchieve: Fluid, organic feel to the script
Balanced negative space on the left

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script is legible despite its vertical orientation.
Ensure the warm tones do not wash out the facial features.
Verify the typographic hierarchy places emphasis on the script.
Confirm the composition feels intimate and introspective.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile portrait + warm lighting + vertical script overlay + condensed sans-serif secondary text.
